title: campanula pusilla var. foudrasii
intro: Campanula pusilla var. foudrasii, commonly known as the alpine bellflower or small bellflower, is a variety of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Campanula pusilla var. foudrasii include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, coughs, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
